accepted.evidence: Turner 3792 khaṇḍá¹ 'broken, fragment' explicitly lists Southeast European Romani xai̦i and Greek Romani xanrík 'a little' (also xandí). The survey prints (je) xajri 'few, a few, little, a little' at p. 137 §3.3.7.1 and xaj(n)ri 'few; little' at p. 143 §3.20.1.5. The optional n and xaj-/xanr- frame align with these Romani comparanda; the exact suffixes differ, so this is a stem-level reflex, not an assertion that Zargari preserves the Greek form's final -k. The source's (je) is optional and excluded from the installed headword. Original PDF, glyph-decoded source audit and imported key checked; no transcription or identity change.
